appearance.extreme: Their hands end in claws. Dark, ridged, and long enough that they hold a cup with their fingertips because the nails won't clear it.
appearance.obvious: Their fingernails are horn, curved and thick, and they have stopped pretending to trim them.
appearance.subtle: Their nails are thick and yellowed, filed to blunt points.

description: Your fingernails have kept growing and kept hardening. They're closer to claws now, and they don't file down.
name: Keratin Nails
